title: Tantrums at Ages Two and Three: Understanding and Prevention
description: Six daily lessons for a parent with a child aged two or three: understanding tantrums, noticing hunger, tiredness and transitions, safety with few words during a tantrum, closeness and naming feelings after the child calms down, understanding the repeated «no» with a few clear limits, and offering two acceptable choices instead of one order, with a calm response that keeps the child safe and meets the child's needs.

primary_reference.info: American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry guidance on tantrums, and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention guidance on child development and safe responses.
